schema.description: A `Corporation` hit snippet: the [TG-FCT-6a] core plus the [TG-FCT-6b] Corporation-surface groups selected by the projection (default set: `trust`, `didCard`). An unselected group is omitted entirely, never `null`.

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`).
did.title: search_response_DidString

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.
lastObservedAtTime.title: search_response_Iso8601DateTime

trust.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `trust` group; never `null`. Present iff selected (default set).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`).
policyAddress.title: search_response_Bech32Address

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.
anyOf.title: search_response_Iso8601DateTime

trust.title: search_response_CorporationTrust

oneOf.description: Inline governance-framework summary (`cgf` / `egf` per [TG-DEREF-2a] / [TG-DEREF-2b]): active version, activation time, and document metadata — never document bodies. `activeSince` is required-present per the [TG-FCT-6b] null-not-omitted rule (`null` when the upstream inline object omits it), even though the persisted entity-table shape writes it as optional.

version.description: Active GF version (integer, per the indexer's inline `cgf` / `egf` surfacing).

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC.
anyOf.title: search_response_Iso8601DateTime

oneOf.title: search_response_GovernanceFrameworkSummary

governance.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `governance` group — the inline `cgf` summary; `null` when the Corporation has not yet published any GF. Present iff selected (opt-in).

didCard.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `didCard` group — the Corporation's own DID as a card. Present iff selected (default set).

oneOf.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `service` group: the VS-level identity asserted by the `ServiceCredential`. The group is `null` (not this object) when the DID presents no ServiceCredential.

pattern.description: Architecture pattern (`Did.pattern`); non-null whenever a ServiceCredential exists.

description.description: `ServiceCredential.description`, optionally truncated for card use (truncation ends at a character boundary and is flagged with a trailing `…`).

oneOf.title: search_response_DidSnippetService

service.description: Same shape and null conditions as the `Did`-surface `service` group.

oneOf.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `operator` group: the operative ORG-or-PERSONA identity the VS's trust chain rests on (Pattern A: self; Pattern B: issuer), per the [TG-FCT-3] derivation. The group is `null` (not this object) when the trust chain is incomplete.

logoUri.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.logoUri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarUri`; `null` for a Persona without avatar.

logoDigestSri.description: Paired `OrganizationCredential.logoDigestSri` or `PersonaCredential.avatarDigestSri`; `null` under the same conditions as `logoUri`.

registryId.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.registryId`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

address.description: Operative `OrganizationCredential.address`; `null` when the operator is a Persona.

oneOf.title: search_response_DidSnippetOperator

operator.description: Same shape and null conditions as the `Did`-surface `operator` group.

didCard.title: search_response_DidCard

schema.title: search_response_CorporationSnippet
